snippet.title: Talystro - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Combine cards, dice, and creative logic to defeat your numerical adversaries! Collect, upgrade and enchant your cards. Discover game-breaking artifacts, power up your dice and defeat the Necrodicer, in this roguelite dice and deckbuilder.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524740/Talystro/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
